mentions.note: Rallied alongside housing optimism on a strong project backlog, suggesting mortgage rates may be easing.
Was huge believer but market proving too hard; switched to Home Depot/Lowes for lower-risk housing supply exposure.
Supply chain beaten down by Home Depot strength; won't follow down the distribution chain.
Not yet time to buy the dip; Home Depot is the better rate-cut-levered housing play.
